notes: Version 2.69 records lot C04 (ENI/NIF premises, measures and inequality status). ENI 2.10 keeps Theorems 3 and 7 and their proofs; it states strict positivity of the projection entropy pointwise on non-degenerate measures, restricts the entropic clauses to finite or countable configuration spaces (renormalisation-group and loop-quantum-gravity applications conditional), gives Corollary 6 its finite-entropy condition and marks the proposed algebraic route from fibre non-commutativity as not established. NIF-Note 1.9 aligns its ENI summaries and no longer lists Gravity, Q12 and Q13 as consumers of ENI's entropy result. White paper 3.24 corrects the projection-entropy definition of Appendix B.23 and Section 13, distinguishing it from the entropy of the image measure.
